title: engenheiro(a) de linhas de transmissão ii
description:
Somos formados por pessoas de diferentes idades e experiências profissionais. No processo de seleção, bem como no desenvolvimento de carreira, aplicamos critérios de não discriminação e igualdade de oportunidades, de acordo com o que recomenda a nossa cultura e nosso Código de Ética e Conduta. A Celeo apoia diversos projetos de cultura, educação, bem-estar, saúde, ações de cidadania, solidariedade, entre outros com o compromisso com a sociedade e acreditando que juntos formamos um time mais forte. Reconhecemos a importância das pessoas para o nosso negócio e buscamos diariamente a construção de ambientes propícios ao desenvolvimento, segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, terceiros e prestadores de serviços, e ainda, da população próxima aos nossos empreendimentos, nos tornando um ótimo lugar para trabalhar todos os dias com #orgulhodeserceleo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar junto à equipe de Novos Negócios na contratação de novos projetos de linhas de transmissão, avaliando e aprovando as questões técnicas de cada projeto, tais como: traçado, fornecedores, soluções de engenharia, projeto, quantidades, interfaces com meio ambiente e fundiário.
  • Atuar durante a implantação de novos projetos por meio da análise técnica do projeto básico e executivo, garantindo que as premissas na fase de contratação sejam cumpridas ou melhoradas. Realizar testes de aceitação em fábrica e due-diligence dos fornecedores, visitar as obras prestando apoio técnico às áreas de projetos e manutenção.
  • Desempenhar suas atividades sob orientação e supervisão de seu gestor imediato, com foco na qualidade, custo, prazo e de acordo com os padrões técnicos, Normas, Procedimentos de Rede, legislações pertinentes e boas práticas de engenharia, visando o cumprimento dos objetivos preestabelecidos para a área e para a empresa.
  • Interação contínua com as áreas de Novos Negócios, Meio Ambiente e Fundiário para definição do traçado das linhas, durante a fase de pré leilão ou desenvolvimento de projetos, indicando soluções de traçado que representem melhor viabilidade técnica e financeira nos âmbitos Fundiário, Meio ambiente e Engenharia.
  • Análise e validação de documentos técnicos elaborados durante os estudos de leilão de transmissão como: característica da LT, definição dos tipos e quantidades de torres e materiais, Lista de Material e Construção, PLSCAD, sondagens
  • Realização de visitas em campo ao traçado proposto, analisando e validando as questões de engenharia
  • Desenvolver ou atualizar especificações técnicas/padrões de engenharia da CRB e garantir a aderência das propostas técnicas à essas especificações e padrões assim como ao Edital do Leilão e Procedimentos de Rede
  • Analisar/aprovar os projetos básico, executivo, especificações técnicas, projetos de linhas de transmissão/materiais (fornecedores), estudos/relatórios técnicos, projetos de travessias, projetos de infraestrutura relacionados a projetos implantação
  • Interagir constantemente durante a etapa de construção com as áreas de Meio Ambiente e Fundiário para analisar e validar possíveis alterações de traçados apresentando impactos e buscando as melhores soluções para os desvios, quando necessário
  • Realizar testes de aceitação em fábrica (TAF's) quando demandado, comunicando os gestores diretos sobre o andamento e resultados e apoiar os gestores dos projetos na análise/aceitação de questões técnicas relacionadas a linha de transmissão
    Realizar due-diligence amostral em fornecimentos e apoiar os gestores de contrato e projetos no acompanhamento das entregas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Necessário Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Civil ou Elétrica;
  • Necessário experiência atuando na área de Linhas de transmissão, com experiência em definição de traçado e definição de estruturas e análise/elaboração de documentos técnicos;
  • Necessário experiência em empresa de energia, preferencialmente em transmissão;
  • Desejável experiência com PSLCAD.

Informações adicionais

Somos uma empresa que participa no desenvolvimento, investimento e gestão de ativos de infraestrutura.

Nossa filosofia baseia-se em:

Capacidade de gerar fluxo de caixa previsíveis a longo prazo.

Melhorar a sustentabilidade do mercado.

Nossos ativos estão centrados majoritariamente na transmissão e na geração de energia renovável no âmbito de programas de parceria público-privada.

Atualmente, Celeo participa na construção e exploração de sistemas de transmissão de energia e geração renovável no âmbito internacional, com ativos na Espanha, Chile, Peru e Brasil, mantendo diversas atividades de promoção em outros mercados da América Latina.

Em contínuo crescimento e graças ao apoio de seus sócios, os Grupos Elecnor e APG, a Celeo se consolida atualmente como reconhecida empresa do setor, administrando um portfólio de projetos pelo valor de investimento total de 4 bilhões de dólares aproximadamente.

A Stone

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura
A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Um(a) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Inbound)
Você será responsável por realizar vendas consultivas de forma receptiva, conectando as necessidades do(a) cliente às nossas soluções financeiras, com foco em um atendimento de excelência.

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá gerir as vendas por meio dos nossos canais de atendimento (chat, WhatsApp e telefone), garantindo agilidade e assertividade.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Coordenar o Projeto Vem com a gente, apoiar equipe de campo nas atividades negociação, extensão de rede, repavimentação, retirada de irregularidade, ações estratégicas de negociação de recuparação de clientes cortados com olhar de faturamento e arrecadação.

  • Conhecimento de extensão de rede de água, Implantação de ligação nova, pavimentação e Adesão de novos clientes, conhecimento sobre faturamento, arrecadação e custo.

Rio


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como
"A marca mais amada do Rio"
e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como

e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"
.

description:
Customer Relationship Manager (Office-Based, World)

Company Overview: Assetara is a leading international developer of AI solutions for cryptocurrency analytics and trading. We are confidently expanding across Asia, Europe,Africa and the USA, offering reliable tools for growth. Join us as a Client Manager: manage the office and build the client base in your region with full company support..

Job Summary:

1. As the primary leader of our new regional office, you will oversee its setup, daily operations, and client interactions. This is a full-time, permanent position focused on building long-term client relationships through our innovative platform.

2. Location: Your country of residence in Asia, Europe, or the USA (remote work during the initial setup phase, with a subsequent transition to office-based work).

Key Responsibilities:

Establishing and managing all aspects of the regional office, including setting up the workspace and operational setup (fully funded by the company).

Training and advising clients on the use of our AI-based financial analytics and trading tools.

Recording photos and videos to promote the office on social media.

Conducting in-person consultations at the office and virtual sessions via Zoom.

Promoting our services through targeted client engagement and using company-provided materials.

Building and developing a client network to support business growth.

Requirements:

Passion for financial technology, AI-driven solutions, and cryptocurrency.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proactive and results-oriented approach.

Proven ability to independently manage operations in a startup environment.

Fluency in your native language.

Ability to work in Asia, Europe, or the USA.

Compensation and Benefits:

Total monthly income: from $500 to $10,000+ depending on product sales volume.

Base salary: $500 per month from the office opening + bonus incentives (the company covers all setup, travel, and material expenses — no personal costs).

Performance bonuses: Earn 8% commission on each client contract you close, paid after completion.

Additional benefits: company-provided promotional materials and professional training.

How to Apply:

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining your interest in innovative technologies and financial independence, and how you see yourself contributing to our mission. We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences and guarantee a response within 48 hours, so you always know where you stand in the process.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment and fostering innovation in the field of financial independence, where hiring decisions are based on skills, potential, and alignment with our values.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Realiza patrulhamento preventivo, tanto interno quanto externo, nas dependências da empresa, com o objetivo de garantir a segurança de colaboradores, visitantes e do patrimônio da organização. Durante as rondas, é responsável por identificar comportamentos suspeitos e agir de forma preventiva para evitar furtos, danos materiais ou outras situações que representem risco à integridade do ambiente.

title: Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant
description:
About TTC

The Testing Consultancy (TTC) is a global specialist software testing company with a focus on helping organizations transform the way they deliver quality software. We have broad capabilities across a wide range of testing areas including SAP testing and TOSCA automation that enable our clients to increase the speed and quality of software development while reducing risk and cost.

Perks of working for TTC

  • Open to C2C
  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Work Life Balance
  • Relaxed Work Environment
  • Growth and Development Opportunities

Summary

The primary purpose of the Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant role is to lead and deliver SAP testing and TOSCA automation services to customers using industry standards and best practices to meet TTC customer requirements. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant may also assist in general application support of SAP production applications and systems, managing relationships with business owners, software vendors, auditors, and internal IT teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong SAP functional knowledge, deep hands on experience with TOSCA automation, and the ability to lead both functional and technical discussions. They must be proactive, strategic, technically strong, and capable of performing hands on work as required.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC
  • Advise on all aspects of QA including SAP specific best practices, establishing metrics, applying leading TOSCA automation strategies, and developing tools and processes to meet quality goals
  • Develop, plan, execute, and maintain SAP test cases, TOSCA scripts, plans, and protocols for solutions under development
  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations
  • Complete User Acceptance Testing to validate the end to end business flow across SAP modules
  • Identify opportunities for SAP test process optimization and TOSCA framework improvements with a focus on continuous improvement and customer value
  • Establish and evolve formal QA processes for SAP projects ensuring that the team is using best practices and scalable TOSCA automation approaches
  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations
  • Work with project management to meet SAP testing milestones and deliver high quality automated and manual testing solutions on time
  • Lead, collaborate, and mentor QA team members on SAP testing methods and TOSCA automation best practices while sharing domain knowledge to expand team capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Hands on experience with TOSCA automation including modules, test case design, execution, and automation framework development
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules such as FIORI, MM, PM, SD, FICO, PP and QM, BW, EWM, BPC, APO, or others
  • Experience automating SAP applications using TOSCA including navigation, test case recording, and building reusable automation assets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to explain SAP and TOSCA technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Why Autronica?

At Autronica, you're joining a leading innovator, supplier, and system integrator of fire and gas safety solutions worldwide. Our products protect lives and assets on land, at sea, and in the energy sectors. We are an international company with offices across the globe, and our HQ is located in Trondheim, Norway's technology hotspot. Autronica's greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees – and we're excited for you to join the team.

Do you want to be part of a highly committed team striving toward our vision of zero loss of lives, no injuries, or damages caused by fire and gas ?

About the role

Autronica is seeking a Regional Sales Manager for Energy sector to grow the company's Fire and Security solutions across the South America. In this role you will engage directly with clients, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and other industrial land contractors, driving project wins and expanding Autronica's presence in the region. The role covers FPSO, LNG, Clean Energy, and conventional energy projects across upstream, midstream, and downstream segments, as well as emerging markets such as Renewables.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will work to ensure alignment, sustainable growth, market leadership and ensure Autronica's solutions continue to protect assets, people, and operations across the energy sector.

Preferred locations for the role are Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo,  Brazil.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities as a Regional Sales Manager will be:

Business Growth & Market Leadership

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with end users, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and industrial contractors as well as explore new applications for our solutions in emerging energy markets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships to expand market penetration and reinforce Autronica's reputation.

Sales & Account Management

  • Deliver accurate forecasts, maintain strong margins, and propose comprehensive fire and gas detection solutions.

Collaboration & Global Alignment

  • Partner with global teams and across functions to engage EPCs, MEPs, engineering firms, and stakeholders and to leverage best practices and market intelligence.

Market Development & Strategy Execution

  • Act as a trusted advisor and build alliances with third-party partners to strengthen market growth.
  • Develop partnerships with end-users, distributors, and industry influencers and ensure Autronica's inclusion on Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) and organize events with distributors.

Commercial Excellence

  • Lead preparation of major bids, ensure compliance with pricing and approvals, and maximize profitability.

Compliance & Values

  • Ensure adherence to Autronica's ethics, EHS requirements, and company policies.
  • Support continuous improvement across the region.

Who we are looking for

To be successful in this role, you'll bring a proactive, results-driven approach and a strong commercial mindset. You combine strategic vision with hands-on engagement, enjoy building lasting relationships with clients and partners, and thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments where you can make a real impact. You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, communicate with clarity and influence, and stay focused and adaptable while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving market.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field (Electronics, Electrical, Automation, Controls or relevant).
  • Diversified sales experience in technology-driven industries.
  • Solid experience in selling safety, automation, or related solutions to EPCs, MEP/contractors, system integrators, or end customers in the energy sector.
  • Established regional network and extensive regional market knowledge.
  • Proven experience in instrumentation sales within the oil & gas sector, combined with a strong track record in pursuing and winning EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) projects.
  • Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

What we offer

We offer excellent development opportunities, a competitive salary and exceptional benefits including the following:

  • An exciting and challenging position in a team with skilled colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions and flexible working time arrangements.
  • A professional work environment where we always strive to deliver and exceed expectations.

Our commitment to you

As an employer of choice, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We aim to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback, and always challenging ourselves to do better.

The values that guide us are respect, integrity, inclusion, innovation, and excellence.

We're excited for you to join us and make a difference.

Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Chief Audit Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Audit Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline

Certifications

  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications:
    • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques

Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

Compensation Range: $240,000 - $260,000

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.

  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.

description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

description:
Join to apply for the Coordenador de TI role at FONS - Consultoria e Soluções

Missão do Cargo

Liderar e coordenar as atividades de tecnologia da informação, assegurando a estabilidade e o desempenho dos sistemas TOTVS voltados à área da saúde, bem como a eficiência da infraestrutura tecnológica e o suporte de excelência aos usuários internos. O profissional deverá atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, garantindo segurança, continuidade e inovação nos processos tecnológicos da instituição.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a área de TI e garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas corporativos;
  • Gerenciar o sistema TOTVS – módulo Saúde, assegurando seu funcionamento, atualizações e integração com demais sistemas;
  • Atuar diretamente no suporte ao usuário interno, solucionando demandas técnicas e aprimorando processos de uso do sistema;
  • Planejar e implementar melhorias tecnológicas aplicadas ao contexto hospitalar e clínico;
  • Gerenciar contratos e relacionamento com fornecedores de tecnologia, prezando por qualidade e custo-benefício;
  • Zelar pela segurança da informação, integridade dos dados e continuidade dos serviços de TI;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de performance da área;
  • Apoiar a Diretoria em decisões estratégicas relacionadas a tecnologia e inovação.

Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Monitorar o desempenho e disponibilidade dos sistemas TOTVS e demais plataformas utilizadas;
  • Supervisionar backups, atualizações, rede interna e infraestrutura de servidores;
  • Atender e direcionar chamados técnicos com foco na satisfação do usuário interno;
  • Manter inventário atualizado de equipamentos e licenças;
  • Promover treinamentos internos sobre uso do sistema e boas práticas de segurança digital;
  • Coordenar equipe de suporte técnico e acompanhar o cumprimento de SLA’s;
  • Realizar interface com áreas administrativas e assistenciais para otimizar fluxos e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com gestores e diretoria.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada mínima de 3 anos na função de Coordenação ou Supervisão de TI;
  • Domínio em TOTVS – módulo Saúde (implantação, suporte e gestão);
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão hospitalar ou clínicas;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura, redes, servidores e segurança da informação;
  • Capacidade de liderar equipes técnicas e gerir demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Atitudes Fundamentais

  • Alfabetização Digital e Fluência Tecnológica;
  • Comunicação Multicanal e Influência Positiva;
  • Gestão de Tempo, Energia e Produtividade Consciente;
  • Inteligência Emocional e Autogestão;
  • Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Responsabilidade e Comprometimento;
  • Autoconhecimento e Inteligência Emocional;
  • Proatividade e Iniciativa;
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade;
  • Comunicação Clara e Empática;
  • Foco em Organização, Planejamento e Entrega.

Salário/Benefícios

  • R$ 6.000,00 (CLT – Presencial)
  • Benefícios
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência anterior na área da saúde (hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, etc.);
  • Certificações na área de tecnologia (ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27001) ou gestão de TI;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos e implantação de sistemas.
  • Outras Informações
  • Horário de trabalho: 09h às 18h
  • Regime de trabalho: CLT Presencial

  • Experiência em coordenação de equipes de infraestrutura.
  • Gestão e liderança de equipes.

  • Sólida experiência em administração de sistemas Linux.
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes de computadores.
  • Domínio de serviços de rede: DHCP, SMB, LDAP, Kerberos.

  • Experiência com serviços de e-mail (Postfix).

  • Experiência com PostgreSQL.

  • Vivência com ambientes virtualizados.
  • Experiência com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em orquestração com Kubernetes.

  • Experiência com computação em nuvem.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade.

Perfil desejado

Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a), com forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas. Valorizamos quem tenha visão estratégica de infraestrutura, saiba equilibrar estabilidade com inovação e tenha habilidade para documentar processos e compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe.
